items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: She used to be the emcee at the Indiana Theater, and we were all young

ctx.x: That’s right. She used to be the emcee at the Indiana Theater, and we were all young, and they’d say, “We’re going to give you Alberta Hunter.” We’d say “booooo.” NS: She was, we’re talking about good improvisation, because she could get one note, and sing that whole line and hold that one note.
